what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Dominica in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 642 asylum seekers from Dominica, and the United States hosted 82.1% of them.
After the United States, the largest hosts are Brazil, Canada and the United Kingdom.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Dominica, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 16 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
